title: Agentic Behavior Engineering: A Design-by-Contract Methodology for Specifying, Verifying, and Governing Enterprise AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.05454v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise teams that deploy large language model (LLM) agents inherit a maintenance problem that traditional testing does not address. The model is non-deterministic, but the larger risk is that most of what changes an agent's behavior (a retired model version, a revised policy, an upstream schema change, a prompt edit meant to fix one case) originates outside the owning team and is discovered as a production defect rather than caught as a regression. This paper presents Agentic Behavior Engineering (ABE), a platform-agnostic methodology that treats observable agent behavior, rather than the prompt or the model, as the version-controlled engineering artifact. ABE adapts Design by Contract to non-deterministic systems. translated_title: 智能体行为工程：一种用于规范、验证与治理企业AI智能体的契约式设计方法论
translated_abstract: 部署大语言模型（LLM）智能体的企业团队面临着一个传统测试无法解决的维护难题。模型本身具有非确定性，但更大的风险在于，改变智能体行为的大多数因素（如模型版本退役、政策修订、上游数据模式变更、为修复某一案例而进行的提示词编辑）都源自负责团队之外，并且往往在生产环境中作为缺陷被发现，而非在测试阶段作为回归问题被捕获。本文提出了智能体行为工程（ABE），这是一种与平台无关的方法论，它将可观察的智能体行为（而非提示词或模型本身）视为受版本控制的工程制品。ABE将契约式设计方法适配到非确定性系统中：一个仅包含规范的行为契约（带有稳定的规则标识符）明确了智能体必须做什么、不得做什么，以及在证据不足时何时应当放弃作答；一个轻量级的场景库将每条规则转化为具体的场景……
tldr: 本文提出智能体行为工程（ABE），一种将可观察的智能体行为而非提示词或模型作为版本控制工程制品的契约式设计方法论，用于解决企业LLM智能体因源自团队外部的行为变更而导致的维护与治理难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Agentic Behavior Engineering (ABE), a Design-by-Contract methodology that treats observable agent behavior—rather than the prompt or model—as the version-controlled engineering artifact, enabling enterprises to specify, verify, and govern LLM agents despite non-deterministic behavior changes originating outside the owning team.
